payment_terms: Future cash contributed by either party will be treated as a loan and repaid first before any profit split, unless both parties sign a written ownership change. Spending above $500 requires both owners’ written approval. Monthly payouts will be made after expenses and after maintaining a 10% operating reserve. Net profits will be split 60/40 unless the parties later agree in writing to a different ownership or repayment structure. Reimbursements, inventory purchases, and tax-related payments will be handled from business funds as reflected in the books and records.
purpose: Services relationship: operative commitments below follow your notes. Commercial scope (summary): handle a lot of day-to-day operations, sourcing beans, staffing help, and social media This agreement sets the rules for the parties’ mobile coffee cart business so the relationship stays clear as the business grows. Party A keeps personal ownership of the trailer/cart, espresso machine, grinder, generator, and most startup equipment unless both parties sign a written transfer. Party B will handle a substantial share of day-to-day operations, bean sourcing, staffing help, and social media, while both parties share responsibility for the business as owners. The parties will run the business under the agreed brand name and keep control of the brand name and social media accounts for the business, not for either person’s separate use. The parties will keep books, records, and bank access in a way that lets both owners see the business’s finances. Spending above the agreed approval threshold requires both owners’ written approval. The parties will treat inventory purchases, reimbursements, taxes, profit calculations, reserve funding, and monthly payouts according to this agreement. Net pro
